name: Ainu Stories
source:
The stories about how Ainu OSU! server was made. What will Aoba and her family handle with the unexpected adventure? See it in the game!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241110111725/https://renai.us/game/ainu]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
這是關於Ainu的osu!伺服器是怎麼建起來的故事。面對這場意外的冒險，青葉和她的家人會怎麼應對？來遊戲裡看看吧！

［摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241110111725/https://renai.us/game/ainu]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]］
